annotations.title: Route an email address to an agent

description:
Choose which agent answers mail to an address, and who it answers.

        Replaces the selected email routing settings. Clearing the agent stops
        automatic replies; restoring it does not replay mail received in between.
        Setting ``email_agent_id`` together with ``clear_agent=True`` is an error.
        With ``email_agent_scope="anyone"``, a stranger can make the agent use its
        allowed tools. Mail without a passing DMARC result gets no reply.
        A custom domain must be verified with inbound and sending on.
        A field left out keeps its value, except that a new agent starts at ``"members"``.

        Returns the updated ``EmailDomainResponse`` as a dict, or
        ``{"error": "<message>"}``.

clear_agent.description: ``true`` stops the agent replying to this address's mail.
clear_agent.title: Clear Agent

email_agent_id.description: Agent that replies to inbound mail, from ``list_agents`` or ``create_agent``.
email_agent_id.title: Email Agent Id

email_agent_scope.description: Who the agent answers: ``members`` (verified members of the workspace whose mail passes DMARC) or ``anyone`` (every sender whose mail passes DMARC and the spam checks). Omitted: the current scope stays; a newly set agent starts at ``members``.
email_agent_scope.title: Email Agent Scope

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: route_email_domain

DnsRecordSchema.description:
One DNS record the tenant must publish for a sending domain.

Covers DKIM CNAMEs, MAIL FROM MX, and SPF TXT records.

name.description: DNS record name/host to publish (e.g. a CNAME's subdomain).
name.title: Name

priority.description: MX priority. Only present for type='MX'; null otherwise.
priority.title: Priority

value.description: DNS record value to publish (e.g. a CNAME target or TXT content).
value.title: Value

DnsRecordSchema.title: DnsRecordSchema

anyOf.description:
Read view for an email domain.

The inbound-action fields (``inbound_enabled``, ``forward_to``,
``forward_rate_per_hour``) surface what the row has configured for
incoming mail.

created_at.description: When this domain was added, ISO 8601 timestamp.
created_at.title: Created At

dns_records.description: DNS records (DKIM, MAIL FROM MX, SPF) the tenant must publish to verify this domain.
dns_records.title: Dns Records

domain.description: The DNS domain mail is sent from.
domain.title: Domain

email_agent_id.description: The agent that answers mail to this address. Null when none does.
email_agent_id.title: Email Agent Id

forward_rate_per_hour.description: Configured cap on forwarded messages per hour, if set.
forward_rate_per_hour.title: Forward Rate Per Hour

forward_to.description: Email addresses inbound mail is forwarded to, if inbound is enabled.
forward_to.title: Forward To

id.description: Unique identifier for this email domain.
id.title: Id

inbound_enabled.description: Whether this domain accepts and forwards inbound mail.
inbound_enabled.title: Inbound Enabled

local_prefix_name.description: Name prefix of a hail_mail address: the part after the '+'. A free name inside the workspace, such as a person or team. Null for kind='custom'.
local_prefix_name.title: Local Prefix Name

local_prefix_workspace.description: Workspace prefix of a hail_mail address: the part before the '+'. It names the workspace, and one workspace only may hold it. Null for kind='custom'.
local_prefix_workspace.title: Local Prefix Workspace

mail_from_domain.description: Custom MAIL FROM domain, if configured. Null when using the provider default.
mail_from_domain.title: Mail From Domain

mail_from_status.description: Verification status of the custom MAIL FROM domain, if one is configured. Secondary to verification_status.
mail_from_status.title: Mail From Status

provider.description: Email sending provider for this domain (currently always 'ses').
provider.title: Provider

receive_ready.description: True when the domain's published MX points at Hail's inbound host. Only populated by POST /{id}/verify on custom domains; null everywhere else.
receive_ready.title: Receive Ready

sends_enabled.description: Send switch for kind='custom' rows. False stops the domain from sending at all: it is skipped by default sender selection and a send that names it explicitly returns 422. Always true for hail_mail rows.
sends_enabled.title: Sends Enabled

updated_at.description: When this domain was last modified, ISO 8601 timestamp.
updated_at.title: Updated At

verified_at.description: When the domain became verified, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until it is.
verified_at.title: Verified At

anyOf.title: EmailDomainResponse
